_comment: Luraph v14.7 sample opcode map. Opcode numbering is per-build (Luraph randomises it), so this is specific to sample_sigil.lua. 'a/b/c/d' are the operand fields as emitted by run_vm.py --mode disasm (parallel arrays j/q/U/c indexed by pc). Confirmed entries are dynamically or statically verified; the rest are to be filled by reading each leaf in func o (see architecture.md).

286.name: JMP
286.effect: C = target; unconditional jump (block terminator in flattened CFG)

shape_hints._comment: operand-shape observations from --mode disasm; not yet confirmed semantics
shape_hints.48: a=0, b=const_index -> likely LOADK/LOADN into a fixed reg
shape_hints.49: a,b,c,d all set -> 3+ operand op (GETTABLE/SETTABLE/arith candidate)
